[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Zyak''' was an officer of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] trained in air-traffic control. 

==History==
{{Quote|Look, flight control, I said I was sorry."<br />"Sorry doesn't count here in Fuel City, pilot.|[[Jan Ors]] and Captain Zyak|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
As of [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], he was stationed in [[Fuel City]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], where he considered he was wasting his life. 

While he was on duty, the [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290 light freighter]] ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' came to the City and his scanners showed that it made an inexplicable stop at station six.<ref name="RAAD">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref> Zyak made a harsh remark to [[Jan Ors|the pilot]], ordering her to leave.<ref name="RA" /> The pilot claimed to have come off from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and was lost while looking for [[Barons Hed]].<ref name="RAAD" /> In reality the pilot was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[agent/Legends|agent]] and she made the stop in order to let fellow agent [[Kyle Katarn]] to the station, and sneak into the ''[[Sulon Star]]''.<ref name="RA" /><ref name="RAAD" /> Her voice was nice enough to mellow Zyak and advise her that [[Missile Battery|missile batteries]] would easily make a mistake after the [[Mission to Sulon|recent trouble]] in Barons Hed.<ref name="RA" /> Zyak said that he could have her permits revoked or ground her for violating [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] airspace; but offered to reduce her penalty after a "personal conference". The pilot showed to be in haste, and Zyak gave her thirty [[Standard second|seconds]] to disappear or his gunner would blow the ship up.<ref name="RAAD" /> 

Later that same day, he completed his shift and was replaced by [[Nomo]]; then he saw exchange of fire all around the station below his tower, and fragmentary comm traffic that came by talked about a [[Lightfight|firefight]] with an intruder. As Nomo was now responsible to handle the situation, he did nothing more than telling a stressful Nomo what to do, while watching the events with [[electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]]. He suggested telling the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|CO]] to be careful with their shots among the [[fuel/Legends|fuel]] tanks, and when he showed no compliance, he suggested to minimize circulation by closing the valves and bleeding the pumps. In all that chaos, a [[Unidentified air-traffic control technician|technician]] informed Zyak of an incoming ship; Zyak suggested to break off, but after a rude response, he scanned and saw again the ''Moldy Crow''. Just then he realized that the nice-voiced pilot was actually an agent who dropped the infiltrator off in the station, and as such was responsible for the battle that was being fought; Zyak ordered the ''Crow'' to be shot down.<ref name="RA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Copy, one-niner-two. Just get that pile of junk off my screen. And be more careful in the future.|Captain Zyak to the ''Moldy Crow''|<ref name="RA" />}}
He had a thin mustache, and a sneer when on duty.<ref name="RA" />

He was disgusted with civilian [[pilot/Legends|pilots]] who often lost their ways or confused orders. However whenever he heard a nice female voice he would try to be a bit more polite. He lamented that because of his post, which comprised mostly of voice communication, he often would never got to see whom those nice voices belonged to.<ref name="RA" />

Even thought he thought Nomo was less than capable, he thought he was not obliged to show him some things after the end of his own duty; although later he decided to stay when the trouble began in Fuel City.<ref name="RAAD" /> Following the near-destruction of Fuel City, Zyak decided to go AWOL rather than face his superiors' wrath, even though [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Nomo]] had been on duty.

==Behind the scenes==
In the audio adaptation of [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'']], he was voiced by [[Tim Russell]].
